meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Searches scientific and technical web content with Exa and extracts page or PDF text from URLs in batches. Supports scholarly discovery with the publication category and academic domain filters. Applies to requests to search the web, look up current research, fetch a page, or extract an article using Exa.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜到最新研究资料,并把网页和 PDF 原文成批提取出来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常查阅最新研究,或需要把网页、PDF 内容整理下来
copy.tagline_en: Search the latest research and pull full text from web pages and PDFs in batches
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often look up current research or need to collect web and PDF text

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可用 Exa 搜索网页,并按 URL 批量提取网页或学术 PDF 的正文文本。做科学、技术类检索时,可加研究论文分类和学术域名白名单来偏向学术来源。使用前需配置 EXA_API_KEY。
howto.when: 当你提出搜索网页、抓取页面、提取文章等请求,或需要查当前研究资料时接管;科学或技术类查询会优先学术来源。

say.text: 搜一下 2024 年关于钙钛矿太阳能电池稳定性的研究论文
say.note: 会按研究论文分类检索并返回结果

say.text: 批量提取这几个 PDF 链接的正文
say.note: 一次调用可处理多个 URL

howto.what_en: With this skill Claude can search the web via Exa and extract page or PDF text from URLs in batches. Scientific and technical queries can use the research paper category and academic domain filters. Requires an EXA_API_KEY.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search the web, fetch a page, or extract an article; scientific and technical lookups favor academic sources.

say_en.text: Search for 2024 research papers on perovskite solar cell stability
say_en.note: Searches with the research paper category

say_en.text: Extract the text of this URL: https://example.com/article
Extract the text from these PDF links in one batch
say_en.note: Handles multiple URLs in one call
